description: Antonov An-2 biplane standing at the Bait Ali Lodge desert camp at Al-Shakiriya in Aqaba governorate near Wadi Rum, moved there from Aqaba airport. Reported to spottingmode by Leo M. Bonnet in October 2022 with no airframe linked, so no registration is available. An aircraft-shaped object is present at the point on Esri imagery of 7 April 2023.
